verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-settable spending cap, budget, or usage alert. What it does document is adjacent: per-request cost reporting (`cost_in_usd_ticks`), Management API monitoring of prepaid credit balances and usage, a prepaid-credits signup flow, and per-tier rate limits. These give visibility or throughput limits, not a configurable bill ceiling or alert. Nothing states that requests stop when credits are exhausted, so the prepaid model cannot be credited as a cap either.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps, budgets, or usage alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
